name: infocapture-card-reader
description: AWS Lambda that reads business cards and badge photos with Claude for InfoCapture.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --external:@aws-sdk/* --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
